question: The value of sqrt{400}+sqrt{0.0121}-sqrt{7.84} is _____
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct square root calculation of each term:

√400 = 20

√0.0121 = 0.11 (since √121 = 11 and 4 decimal places become 2)

√7.84 = 2.8 (since √784 = 28 and 2 decimal places become 1)

Expression: 20 + 0.11 − 2.8 = 17.31

**∴ The correct answer is 17.31.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** √400 + √0.0121 − √7.84

**Step-by-step evaluation:**

⇒ √400 = 20

⇒ √0.0121 = √(121/10000) = 11/100 = 0.11

⇒ √7.84 = √(784/100) = 28/10 = 2.8

**Substitute back into the expression:**

⇒ 20 + 0.11 − 2.8

⇒ 20.11 − 2.8

⇒ 17.31

**∴ The correct answer is 17.31.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Roots of Decimals

When taking the square root of a decimal, the number of decimal places in the result is exactly half of those in the original number.

Perfect Squares to Remember

Knowing squares up to 30 is helpful: 11² = 121, 20² = 400, 28² = 784.

BODMAS Rule

Always perform addition and subtraction from left to right after solving the roots.</p
